title: Room picture and oral check record sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: My new home; my room and furniture; describing my appearance and clothes
source: Written for arabic/y5 lesson 7 (Room picture and oral check record sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 7: Where is it? In, on, under; oral check. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Where is the book?
points: The book is on the table

panels.title: More examples
points: الحَقِيبَةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ: the bag is under the bed
الثِّيَابُ فِي الخِزَانَةِ: the clothes are in the wardrobe
الكُرْسِيُّ بِجَانِبِ المَكْتَبِ: the chair is next to the desk

box.title: Draw your room with four pieces of furniture (no people). Under it, write where three things are with فِي، عَلَى، تَحْتَ or بِجَانِبِ.

questions.q: Answer: أَيْنَ الكِتَابُ؟ (it is in the bag)
Say 'the chair is next to the window'.
Core: Look at a picture of a room (portal worksheet) and write four 'where' sentences.
questions.a: For example: السَّرِيرُ بِجَانِبِ النَّافِذَةِ. الكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ. الحَقِيبَةُ تَحْتَ الكُرْسِيِّ. الثِّيَابُ فِي الخِزَانَةِ.

questions.q: Extend: Prepare your oral check: three sentences about your own room using one position word.
questions.a: For example: فِي غُرْفَتِي سَرِيرٌ. السَّرِيرُ بِجَانِبِ النَّافِذَةِ. غُرْفَتِي صَغِيرَةٌ.

questions.q: Stretch: Ask a partner three أَيْنَ؟ questions and write their answers.
questions.a: Questions with أَيْنَ and full answers with فِي، عَلَى، تَحْتَ

options: The bag is on the bed
The bag is under the bed
The bag is in the bed
questions.a: B) The bag is under the bed. تَحْتَ (tahta) means under.

questions.q: Which word means 'under'? A) فِي B) عَلَى C) تَحْتَ
Big question: say exactly where your pencil is now.
